question: GQ-009
subject: a delivery route that exists, after a day of "zero push routes"
the_claim_i_was_carrying: "Zero working push routes — all 6 tailnet peers offline." Half right, and the wrong half mattered.

what_was_actually_true.peer_detail: shaans-macbook-pro-1 reports "active ... tx 531336 rx 0" — transmitting, nothing returning. Ping timed out twice. Genuinely unreachable.
what_was_actually_true.but: tailscale serve was already running five tailnet-only proxies, and a Funnel was already live on 8444. I never ran `tailscale serve status`.

a_wrong_conclusion_i_nearly_published.thought: the public funnel on 8444 is a dead route — curl to localhost:8444 returned 000
a_wrong_conclusion_i_nearly_published.actual: 8444 is TLS-terminated at Tailscale's edge; it proxies to 127.0.0.1:8085, which IS listening and returns 200
a_wrong_conclusion_i_nearly_published.lesson: 000 from localhost against a proxied HTTPS port measures my curl, not the service.

what_i_built.what: the observatory served over the tailnet at https://shaans-mac-mini.tail100d11.ts.net:8845/
what_i_built.binding: 127.0.0.1 only; tailscale serve proxies to it
what_i_built.durability: launchd com.siso.librarian-observatory, RunAtLoad + KeepAlive, plutil OK, launchctl list shows exit status 0

verified_end_to_end.freshness: page md5 CHANGED after npm run observatory:build — it serves live files, not a snapshot
verified_end_to_end.content: decision 8 (oracle-gate) confirmed visible to a browser

outbox_now_readable.was: three .md files in outbox/ with no route, counted but unreadable
outbox_now_readable.now: rendered in full on the served page inside <details> blocks
outbox_now_readable.why: a count Shaan cannot read is the exact defect the list-rendered-as-count gate exists to catch

deliberately_not_done: I did NOT put this on the public Funnel. The page carries 39 absolute home paths and a section headed "Escalations you have not seen". Tailnet is Shaan's private network; the funnel is the open internet. That is his call, not mine.
